knowledge.title: Delivery support
knowledge.content: Deliveries usually take 2–4 working days after dispatch. If a parcel is late, check its current status and ask a support operator to investigate.

skills.name: Late delivery triage
skills.content: For a late delivery, read the current order status with the approved order-status tool. Explain the returned status and cite the delivery policy. When delivery information is missing or an exception is needed, propose escalation to a human. Never promise a delivery date or refund that the backend has not confirmed.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Read the authenticated customer's order status. Returns order_id, status, and tracking_url only.
